en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a riverside view of a large church with a tall clock tower and adjoining episcopal residence on a hill above the Elbe River. Below the buildings are terraced gardens, trees, small houses and people near the riverbank. Printed captions in German identify the location as Leitmeritz on the Elbe and describe the cathedral and bishop's residence.
